verdict.rationale: Runloop runs agent code in remote, isolated Devbox sandboxes, so host secrets are not present in the execution environment. Agent Gateways let agents call LLM APIs without ever seeing the API keys, and MCP Hub gives agents tool access without exposing credentials; egress network policies add a further control. Account secrets are injected as environment variables only when the user configures them. Missing for 10: documentation of the underlying isolation boundary (VM vs container) and of how credential-hiding is enforced, independent or hands-on corroboration.
